title: Ingredient selection grid

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Make state change visible without moving the item so people can understand what has been selected.
strategic_value: A quiet green selection field can connect Sweetgreen’s ingredient chooser to its palette while preserving food visibility.
demonstration: Twelve ingredient tiles form a three-column grid; selected tile backgrounds change from cream to muted green while photographs and names remain in place.
practical_value: Compare selected and unselected states using the same ingredient tile structure.

content_islands.name: Tile grid
content_islands.spec: Arrange photographs above names in twelve evenly sized cells.

content_islands.name: Selection sequence
content_islands.spec: Change selected cell fills while keeping positions, labels and images stable.

reference_purposes.Application: The animation demonstrates selection feedback within an ingredient grid.
reference_purposes.Expression: Muted green selected tiles complement the ingredient photography.

ingredient.name: Ingredient tile selection fill
ingredient.role: Distinguish chosen ingredients without replacing their images.
ingredient.application: Change the tile background for selection while retaining image and label, as shown.
ingredient.scope: Observed interface example; no accessibility threshold, interaction specification or exact color value is supplied.
